Analyze stock basis and a cash distribution under simplified stated assumptions.

exhibits.title: Shareholder information
exhibits.html: Beginning stock basis $35,000; capital contribution $5,000; allocated income $10,000. The shareholder also guarantees a $60,000 bank loan but makes no payment.

exhibits.title: Distribution assumptions
exhibits.html: The corporation distributes $55,000 cash. There are no accumulated C-corporation earnings and profits or other adjustments. The guarantee alone provides no basis in this case.

explanation:
Stock basis before distribution

$35,000 + $5,000 + $10,000 = $50,000.

Basis created solely by the guarantee

The guarantee alone does not create basis under the supplied facts.

Gain on distribution

$55,000 exceeds $50,000 stock basis by $5,000.

Ending stock basis

The distribution reduces basis to zero; the excess is recognized gain.
